name: Mall Floor Direction Sign
summary: A midnight-blue and porcelain modular floor sign with an orange level badge and four replaceable directional cartridges.
description: Original freestanding North Walk wayfinding totem with a weighted base, satin aluminium details and independent dining, shopping, cinema and facilities labels.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials. Blender bundled Bfont is retained as editable source text and exported as mesh geometry. No external models or textures.

replacement.note: Edit the Blender source text and arrows within the named collections, save, then use generate.py -- --export-source. Rebuilding without that option replaces manual edits. No live label editing is offered by the gallery.

accuracy_notes: Original decorative concept, not an official mall sign, accessibility standard, route plan, fabrication or structural engineering specification.

attribution.credit: Original geometry authored for Blender-3D-Gallery. Labels use bundled Blender Bfont; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
